title: Act V, Scene I

teacherSummary.text: In Mantua Romeo dreams happily. Balthasar arrives saying Juliet is dead. Romeo resolves to die beside her and buys poison from a poor apothecary.

vocabulary.context:

contentNotes.teacherNote: Believing Juliet dead, Romeo buys poison from the apothecary to die beside her. Use the safe-messaging script; focus on misinformation and haste, not the method. This section mentions drinking or a drug (“…will. Put this in any liquid thing you will, And drink it off; and, if you had the strength Of…”). Treat it as period custom or plot detail; name it plainly and don't glamorize it.
contentNotes.studentPreview: A character decides to take his own life after false news. Support is available if this is hard to read.
contentNotes.suggestedLanguage: “What mistake drives Romeo's decision, and how might it have been prevented?”

safeMessaging.teacherScript: Discuss the character's despair and what the text does with it; do not dwell on methods. Before the lesson, remind students that support is available and how to reach the counselor. Check in privately with any student who seems affected and follow your school's referral protocol.
